data.title: Display a bounded measured point cloud
data.summary: A licensed 10000-point sample with XYZ units and optional color. An LLM-assisted recipe with a concrete practice case, visual procedure and review gates.

facts.text: Three.js Points displays point geometry with a points material.

prerequisites: An authorized Three.js / WebXR environment and a recorded tool version. Blender-specific references here are pinned to the 4.5 manual; check differences in your installed version.
Practice inputs: A licensed 10000-point sample with XYZ units and optional color.

Permission to use the source assets and a writable derived-output location. Use a disposable project copy for edits. An MCP connection is optional; reviewed scripts or manual tool actions can follow the same procedure.
steps: Inspect the existing project, asset registry and target runtime for an equivalent point cloud view workflow. Reuse the closest source and preserve its original files.

Give Claude Code, Codex or another authorized coding assistant this practice brief: A licensed 10000-point sample with XYZ units and optional color. Ask for a small plan and parameter/script diff; verify names and APIs against the installed tool version before applying it.
Validate numeric values and center a display copy around a recorded local origin
Create a BufferGeometry/Points representation without inventing surface triangles
Add bounds, density controls and a text summary of sample size and units

Save the derived candidate separately, record software versions and source/output identities, then perform the acceptance checks. Keep unresolved quality, performance and rights questions in the receipt.
data.output: A versioned display a bounded measured point cloud candidate, the input/parameter table, source identity and a review receipt with the checks below.
validation: Invalid coordinates are reported and excluded explicitly
The display transform can map a selected point back to its source row
Record actual observations separately from expected results; missing tests remain unrun.
limitations: A point cloud is not a watertight mesh or a complete surface reconstruction.
Sintra-authored proposal, not an executed Blender/engine/solver test. The diagram illustrates the procedure and is not a render or execution receipt.
Cloud chat cannot directly control a local 3D app without an appropriate authorized bridge. Tool access, model availability, paid services and rendering resources must be checked separately.
tips: Use chunking or a dedicated point-cloud stack for larger captures.
Let the LLM draft and explain bounded changes; use deterministic software to measure geometry, calculate trajectories and validate files.

data.prompt: Help me display a bounded measured point cloud in [existing authorized project]. First find an equivalent asset/workflow and inspect the installed tool version. Practice brief: A licensed 10000-point sample with XYZ units and optional color. Propose the smallest parameter or script diff and explain each tool action. Follow the linked procedure, preserve original assets and stop on missing inputs or unsupported APIs. Check: Invalid coordinates are reported and excluded explicitly; The display transform can map a selected point back to its source row. Return actual observations, source/output identities and blockers. Do not call expected results completed tests or publish private source paths.
